entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states via temporal reasoning. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service, utilizing multi-signal retrieval to maintain context.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It employs a three-tier loading strategy to achieve a 91% token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs that combine vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning. It supports integration through Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients to facilitate complex search and discovery.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that extracts typed entity edges to create a self-wiring knowledge graph. It generates synthesized prose answers featuring citations and gap analysis while ensuring data isolation through multi-user scoped access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month using a custom vector graph engine. It features automated fact extraction and byte-level deduplication to provide a 100% prompt-cache discount.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows compatible with over 25 LLM providers. It offers flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud, supported by client libraries for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This FastAPI-based library serves as the foundation for stateful agents by extracting conclusions from conversation history for reasoning-first memory. It supports managed and self-hosted Docker Compose deployments with dedicated Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider implements memory as a git-like repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms response times across 20 supported LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local data storage and sub-millisecond performance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like playbooks and context bundles to assist with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate improvements in context quality.
entries.MemTensor/memmy-agent: This local memory hub provides a shared, fully controlled context across multiple agents including Claude Code and Hermes. It offers a desktop application, TUI, and an OpenAI-compatible API to manage local memory via a dedicated CLI.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides a lossless, DAG-based context engine for Hermes Agent that ensures no messages are lost. It utilizes a local SQLite store with FTS metadata and includes specialized tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho enables private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through a self-hosted backend. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer offers portable state across Hermes Agent and other major clients with a 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy. It allows users to import data from external sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to build agent knowledge.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur serves as a shared memory layer that stores data as human-readable YAML engrams on a local disk. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and local embeddings to facilitate retrieval across multiple agent tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, using hybrid retrieval involving both vector search and BM25.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% in tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based, long-term memory system that avoids vector databases and embeddings in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled result. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local cache. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide an MCP-native server for coding agent clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It functions as a local-first MCP server that renders workspace state into specific context files like AGENTS.md.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This plugin provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only provider uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed context layer that stores project state, identity, and decision logs in plain Markdown files. It facilitates session handoffs and checkpoints through hash-checked proposals and provides adapters for Hermes, Claude Code, and other coding agents.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports real, immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation to ensure transparency in prefetch operations.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to pay for services and APIs to charge for access using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains. It integrates with Hermes to settle payments directly to wallets with 0% transaction fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations for capability routing. It offers tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, using feedback to improve local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider that utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox. It features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots alongside tools for searching and updating state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory within Hermes Agent. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution offering AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It utilizes a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage and offers five slash commands for capturing, recalling, and reviewing evidence-cited diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology for autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design system for macOS and Windows that generates prototypes and documents using real CSS and components. It features a coding-agent CLI that supports Hermes Agent alongside DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for specialized security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram presets and features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router for mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. it includes a verification and dispute resolution layer to facilitate secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using five optional voice profiles. It is compatible with agentskills.io-compliant platforms, including Claude Code and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory for persistent context.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,153 skills with native support for Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes ready-to-paste exports for other assistants and integrations for platforms like Slack, Telegram, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports tools like Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains and reports findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for Pydantic AI through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexity and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source file edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running agents using a mechanism kernel that operates without a background service. It manages four distinct roles—Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer—and requires Herdr for hosting supervisor rooms.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts, supporting CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project provides a collection of skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for the Portuguese-speaking community. It includes installation and configuration guides that adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned instruction files compliant with agentskills.io. It links instructions to specific source lines and includes lifecycle tooling for creating and testing skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution for installations and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step task execution with autonomous tracking of progress and decisions. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project provides a local-first workflow language for AI that uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to execute tasks. It ensures operational safety by auditing cost ceilings, secret flows, and types before spending tokens, while generating hash-chained receipts for verifiable run history.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for credential validation and maintains secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a five-layer retrieval system—including hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings—to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It optimizes token efficiency and features graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This community hub facilitates the browsing, search, and one-click installation of skills using the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows an AI agent to handle system design via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while the user focuses on task completion.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and integration analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition and mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task states.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill employs specialized sub-agents for hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Rust, and Go. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for all changes.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and uses SKILL.md files to facilitate progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation based on real-world CVEs. It integrates 28 different frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and NIST.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides production-tested skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode, featuring session management for memory between conversations. It enables parallel subagent orchestration for code reviews and includes tools for worktree recovery and state drift detection.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes files to remain under 8 MB and embeds the rendered results directly into the documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable Agent Skills from plain language while preventing skill rot. It utilizes a validator to detect drift against runtime-specific profiles and monitors official frontmatter specs weekly.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop analyzes session history to identify and propose improvements for AI agent skill coverage. It gates updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators using only the Python standard library.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills directly from a terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Designed for Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL, these skills manage deterministic path routing for file operations. They also facilitate the selection and verification of existing, project-compatible Python interpreters.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides real-time monitoring of token costs, health, sessions, and errors with zero outbound telemetry. It features 11 monitoring tabs and an optional script for Telegram and Feishu incident alerts.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides functional quality certification for agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties, buying context, and creating bounty boards.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports with core conclusions and uses semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Compatible with the agentskills.io standard, this suite includes tools for video-to-text, OCR, and AI writing refinement. Support for macOS and Linux varies depending on specific skill requirements.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project enables Hermes Agent to access structured web data across 31 platforms by exposing 191 tools through a hosted MCP server. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports integration with environments such as Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for Hermes, covering CLI tools, desktop applications, and agentic IDEs. It is included for users seeking a reproducible way to manage AI coding agents across various environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers scripts and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent on ARM64 Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and UI access.
entries.praveen-ks-2001/hermes-agent-template: This one-click Railway template deploys Hermes Agent with a web-based admin dashboard for managing provider setups, gateway logs, and user pairing. It simplifies cloud deployment by including persistent volume support and a password-protected proxy for the native UI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line Termux installation script to run Hermes Agent on Android with support for over 70 tools and persistent memory. It enables the use of both external providers and local models via Ollama integration.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It extends mobile functionality by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level while allowing configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes, offering monitoring tools for metrics and LLM budget caps. It provides multiple interfaces for agent management, including a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted directories and supports building specific Hermes tags via build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative Hermes deployments with secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd. It supports a hybrid skill management system, allowing users to manage skills through both Nix and the Hermes CLI.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution enables the Hermes Agent to run directly from USB or external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It provides a self-contained production environment bundling Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline settings.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It features a dedicated researcher team for bullish and bearish debates, alongside risk management and portfolio manager agents for final decision approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI, CLI, or REST API. It supports multi-agent workflows and memory browsing with deployment options via Node.js or Docker.
entries.tutti-os/tutti: Tutti provides a collaborative workspace where human users and agents build together using shared files and real-time context. The system connects existing agents using current subscription credits and includes an app ecosystem for UI design and image generation.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, across persistent tmux sessions for background execution. It supports multi-repo management via Git worktrees and provides environment sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.Orkas-AI/Orkas: Orkas is a desktop client where a commander LLM dispatches nine built-in specialist agents in parallel or series for research, media, and development. The system stores all data locally and supports self-evolution through reflection and skill crystallization.
entries.rlaope/oh-my-hermes: This package adds an operating layer to Hermes Agent that provides planning, research, and long-term project memory. It integrates with Hermes Desktop and CLI applications and can be installed via Homebrew, Bun, or npm.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain for managing specialist teams and orchestrated workflows. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and includes detection for payment-required states for paid APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage and view agent team delegations.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It enforces human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents across research, planning, quality, and infrastructure domains. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for tool handling and provides a real-time UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization framework automates the outer-loop refinement of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while utilizing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to improve agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This project creates a competitive arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by Hermes Agent and Paperclip, compete for GitHub stars. It orchestrates nine agents across these organizations and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize task execution, code generation, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a fully-local Mixture-of-Agents stack that utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, leveraging parallel model querying and synthesis to execute complex workflows.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that pre-indexes TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python files. It integrates with Hermes Agent to reduce token usage and tool calls by auto-syncing the index on every file change.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based utility that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a TUI and a 3D contribution graph dashboard, allowing users to submit data for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools through a self-contained HTML viewer. It prioritizes security by redacting common authentication headers before recording exported trace sessions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to help developers build better interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical usage breakdowns categorized by session, project, and model.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project serves as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for app development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments to streamline building and shipping processes.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce through Solana-based payments and supports identity registration using human-readable handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports various providers like Anthropic and OpenAI while offering undo functionality for recent agent-driven changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, including a plugin for Claude Code with automatic context recall. It also offers chat bots for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, supported by an automated cross-platform installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents through local configurations and skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup for free models and includes support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It flags vague descriptions and missing termination conditions, supporting SARIF output for integration with GitHub Code Scanning.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services to facilitate the move.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes config-aware baselines by watching local files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant for Hermes Agent offers offline, open-mic functionality with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys or user accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup is a local-first skill designed for online monetization using dynamic slash commands and a deterministic local runtime. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports semantic search and multi-dimensional storage through the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, serves as an all-in-one configuration tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes the management of Hermes Agent alongside other command-line interfaces like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and enables remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one location.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard featuring a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and execution history. It enables unified configuration across 10 messaging platforms, such as Telegram and Discord, while tracking token consumption via local SQLite storage.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated memory browser to manage agent skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features specialized native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering alongside dedicated modules for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime directly to the active browser context. It includes site-aware drafting tools for 31 writing environments and live browser control governed by explicit approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from iOS 18+ devices. It allows for real-time chat and server file system browsing without the use of subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage. It provides a live monitoring environment specifically for observing code writes and diffs in real time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor provides an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health via kanban pipelines. It serves as an MCP server control plane that supports real-time chat with streaming and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that attributes live quota burn to individual agent sessions while operating locally with no telemetry. It provides searchable transcripts for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs to serve as a private agent cockpit and analytics tracker.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard functions as a Telegram Mini App with support for background agent spawning of up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to connect Hermes to cloud or local models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside integrated support for ComfyUI and workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard tracks real-time session activity and costs while allowing full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code. It provides read-only access to configuration settings and environment variables for process oversight.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring chat with SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client features a PM orchestrator to manage collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a native interface that supports streaming responses and model switching.
